explanation: Retrospective detector for the specifier word that opens or completes a formulaic chunk: the first content word of a new paragraph, list item, heading, or comment after a boundary marker (blank line, bullet, #, //), or the conventional slot-filler after a light head word such as offer, Add, of, for, Group, Heat, configure, General, or Hi (e.g. Valid(ating) after a title plus blank line, whole after dried/offer, Chronic after Treatment of, 1 after Heat, active after configure, Information after General). The same word fires weakly without its frame (whole after The, the after a blank line) or with a non-conventional filler (new for active, sweet for whole), while the slot generalizes across fillers (Heat 1 versus 9, Chronic versus severe).
